MODULE.NAME: M-RTK-FULL-PARITY
MODULE.PURPOSE: Full RTK parity matrix — compares rtk-develop command, hook, and command-module surfaces against Synapse implemented, equivalent, superseded, and missing coverage.
MODULE.SCOPE: Source-derived RTK top-level command parsing, hook processor parsing, multi-agent hook install target coverage, command-module inventory, Synapse implemented/equivalent/superseded/missing coverage classification including proxy-equivalent RTK command modules, full parity JSON/text rendering, and CI failure semantics for --full.
